name: TRANBKP.jcl
description:
This JCL job (TRANBKP) performs a three-phase backup and refresh cycle for the Credit Card Transaction Master VSAM file: it first copies all transaction records to a versioned backup, then deletes the existing VSAM cluster and its alternate index, and finally recreates a fresh empty VSAM cluster ready for new transactions.Key Functionalities:
Backs up the Transaction Master VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) by copying all 350-byte fixed-length transaction records into a new generation of the backup GDG dataset (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP(+1)), preserving a versioned history of transactions.
Deletes the existing Transaction Master VSAM cluster (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) and its associated Alternate Index (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.AIX), suppressing non-critical errors (return codes up to 8) to ensure a clean removal.
Recreates the Transaction Master VSAM KSDS cluster from scratch with a 16-byte key starting at position 0, fixed record size of 350 bytes, allocated on volume AWSHJ1 with 1 primary and 5 secondary cylinders, and share options (2,3), making it ready to accept new transaction data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The live Card Transaction VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) exists and contains Card Transaction records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Transaction backup process (PRC001) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Every Card Transaction record from the live VSAM file is copied in full to the backup file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP) with no filtering, selection, or exclusion applied — the backup is a complete and exact copy of all transaction data

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO - Full Card Transaction Data Backup
rules.Rule_Description: All Card Transaction records from the live VSAM file must be completely copied to a backup file without any filtering or selection criteria.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: One or more prior backup generations of Card Transaction data already exist in the backup dataset (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Transaction backup process (PRC001) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A new next-generation backup (+1) is created and permanently registered in the system catalog, while all previously created backup generations are retained and remain accessible — backup history is never overwritten

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO - Versioned Backup Generation for Card Transaction Data
rules.Rule_Description: Each execution of the backup process must create a new sequential backup generation, preserving all prior backup versions of Card Transaction data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new Card Transaction backup generation is being created during the backup process
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backup process encounters an error or fails to complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The incomplete backup file is automatically removed from the system and deregistered from the catalog — no partial or corrupt Card Transaction backup is retained under any failure condition

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO - Backup Integrity Protection on Failure
rules.Rule_Description: If the Card Transaction backup process fails, the incomplete backup must be automatically discarded to prevent corrupt or partial backup data from being retained.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Card Transaction records are being copied from the live VSAM file to the backup file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each Card Transaction record is written to the backup file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Every record in the backup file is stored as exactly 350 bytes in fixed-length format (LRECL=350, RECFM=FB), ensuring the backup record structure is identical to the source Card Transaction VSAM file structure

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO - Card Transaction Backup Record Format Consistency
rules.Rule_Description: Card Transaction records written to the backup file must conform to a fixed 350-byte record structure, maintaining consistency with the source VSAM file format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction backup process (PRC001) is actively reading the live Card Transaction VSAM file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Other business jobs or processes request read access to the Card Transaction VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) at the same time
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The backup process reads the live transaction file in shared mode (DISP=SHR), allowing all other jobs to simultaneously read Card Transaction data without any interruption or delay to their processing

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO - Non-Blocking Concurrent Access to Card Transaction Data During Backup
rules.Rule_Description: The Card Transaction backup process must not block or interrupt other business processes that need to read Card Transaction data while the backup is running.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction backup file has been allocated with initial storage space of 1 cylinder (primary) and 1 cylinder (secondary expansion)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backup process completes and the total data written does not consume all allocated storage
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All unused storage space beyond what is actually occupied by the backed-up Card Transaction records is automatically released back to the system (RLSE), ensuring no storage is unnecessarily reserved

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO - Automatic Release of Unused Backup Storage
rules.Rule_Description: Any storage space allocated for the Card Transaction backup file that is not used after the backup completes must be automatically released back to the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM Cluster (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) exists on the system
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Transaction file rebuild process is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entire Card Transaction VSAM Cluster including its DATA component (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS.DATA) and INDEX component (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS.INDEX) must be permanently deleted from the system

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Delete Card Transaction VSAM Cluster
rules.Rule_Description: The Card Transaction VSAM Cluster, which stores all active Card Transaction records along with its internal data and index structures, must be fully removed from the system to allow a clean recreation of the file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A delete operation has been attempted on the Card Transaction VSAM Cluster (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete operation returns a condition code of 8 or below (including the case where the file was already absent or did not exist)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The condition code must be reset to 0 (success) and the process must continue to the next step without raising an error, treating the deletion as fully successful

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Tolerate Absent Card Transaction VSAM Cluster During Deletion
rules.Rule_Description: The deletion of the Card Transaction VSAM Cluster must be treated as successful even when the file does not exist, ensuring the rebuild process is not blocked by a pre-existing absent file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction Alternate Index (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.AIX) exists on the system
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Transaction file rebuild process proceeds after the VSAM Cluster deletion
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Transaction Alternate Index (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.AIX) must be permanently deleted from the system as an Alternate Index type object

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Delete Card Transaction Alternate Index
rules.Rule_Description: The Alternate Index associated with the Card Transaction VSAM file, which provides a secondary access path to transaction records, must be fully removed from the system alongside the main cluster deletion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A delete operation has been attempted on the Card Transaction Alternate Index (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.AIX)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete operation returns a condition code of 8 or below (including the case where the Alternate Index was already absent or did not exist)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The condition code must be reset to 0 (success) and the process must complete successfully without raising an error, treating the Alternate Index deletion as fully successful

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Tolerate Absent Card Transaction Alternate Index During Deletion
rules.Rule_Description: The deletion of the Card Transaction Alternate Index must be treated as successful even when the Alternate Index does not exist, ensuring the rebuild process is not blocked by a pre-existing absent index.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file recreation step (STEP10) is about to be triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Any prior job step (backup or deletion) returned a return code greater than 4, indicating a significant error occurred
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: STEP10 is entirely skipped and the Card Transaction VSAM file is NOT recreated, preventing the creation of a file in an unreliable or inconsistent environment; AND when all prior job steps completed with return codes of 4 or less, STEP10 executes and proceeds to recreate the Card Transaction VSAM file

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Conditional Execution of Card Transaction File Recreation
rules.Rule_Description: STEP10 is conditionally executed based on the success of all prior job steps. The Card Transaction VSAM file is only recreated if the backup and deletion steps completed without significant errors.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: STEP10 is executing and all prior steps completed with return codes of 4 or less
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Transaction VSAM file definition command is issued
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A new empty Card Transaction VSAM file named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS is created on storage volume AWSHJ1 as an indexed, key-sequenced file, containing zero records and ready for data load by subsequent jobs

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Card Transaction VSAM File Creation
rules.Rule_Description: When STEP10 executes successfully, a new empty Card Transaction VSAM file is created on the designated storage volume, ready to receive transaction data from subsequent jobs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file is being defined
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The key structure of the file is configured
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first 16 bytes of every Card Transaction record, starting at position 0 (the very beginning of the record), are designated as the unique Transaction ID (primary key); this key is used to uniquely identify, retrieve, and sequence all Card Transaction records within the file

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Transaction ID Primary Key Definition
rules.Rule_Description: Each Card Transaction record is uniquely identified by a 16-character Transaction ID located at the very beginning of the record, enabling fast and direct lookup of individual transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file is being defined with record size constraints
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record size configuration is applied to the file definition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Both the minimum and maximum record size are set to exactly 350 bytes, meaning every Card Transaction record stored in this file must be precisely 350 bytes — no shorter and no longer — enforcing a fixed-length record structure for all transactions

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Card Transaction Record Size Enforcement
rules.Rule_Description: All Card Transaction records stored in the VSAM file must conform to a strict fixed length of exactly 350 bytes, enforcing uniform record structure across all transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file is being created on storage volume AWSHJ1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Storage space is allocated for the file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: 1 cylinder of primary storage is allocated immediately upon file creation; AND if the initial 1 cylinder becomes full due to growing transaction volume, the system automatically allocates additional storage in increments of 5 cylinders at a time to accommodate the increased data

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Card Transaction File Storage Allocation
rules.Rule_Description: The Card Transaction VSAM file is allocated with an initial storage capacity and configured to automatically expand in defined increments when transaction volume grows beyond the initial allocation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file is defined with the data erasure policy enabled
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Transaction VSAM file is deleted at any point in the future
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All Card Transaction data stored in the file is physically overwritten and permanently erased from the storage disk; the data cannot be recovered or reconstructed after deletion, ensuring full protection of sensitive card transaction information

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Card Transaction Sensitive Data Erasure on Deletion
rules.Rule_Description: To protect sensitive Card Transaction data, the file is configured so that all data is physically overwritten and permanently erased from disk whenever the file is deleted, preventing any possibility of data recovery.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file is being defined with access sharing rules
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The share options are configured for the file (SHAREOPTIONS 2 3)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Multiple jobs running within the same system are permitted to read Card Transaction data simultaneously, while write access is controlled to prevent data corruption (cross-region share option 2); AND multiple systems across the enterprise are permitted to access the Card Transaction file concurrently (cross-system share option 3)

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Card Transaction File Multi-Job Access Configuration
rules.Rule_Description: The Card Transaction VSAM file is configured to support simultaneous access by multiple business jobs and systems, enabling concurrent read operations while managing write access to protect data integrity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Transaction VSAM file creation command is executing in STEP10
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Two internal components are created simultaneously: (1) a DATA component named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS.DATA, which physically stores all Card Transaction records; AND (2) an INDEX component named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS.INDEX, which maintains the Transaction ID key structure enabling fast and direct retrieval of individual transaction records

rules.Rule_Name: STEP10 - IDCAMS - Card Transaction File Dual Component Creation
rules.Rule_Description: The Card Transaction VSAM file is physically composed of two distinct internal components — a Data Component and an Index Component — both of which are created simultaneously as part of a single file definition operation.

flowchart TD
    classDef start fill:#ff6666,stroke:#333,color:#000,font-weight:bold
    classDef process fill:#6699ff,stroke:#333,color:#000,font-weight:bold

    classDef success fill:#22c55e,stroke:#333,color:#000,font-weight:bold
    classDef error fill:#ef4444,stroke:#333,color:#fff,font-weight:bold

    A([🚀 JOB START
Card Transaction VSAM File Re-initialization Process]):::start

    %% ─── PRC001: BACKUP STEP ───
    B[PRC001 - IDCAMS REPRO
Create Point-in-Time Backup of All
Card Transaction Records into GDG Backup]:::process

    DS1[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS
📂 Live Card Transaction VSAM File
Source of All Transaction Records)]:::datasource

    DS2[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP +1
📦 Card Transaction GDG Backup File
New Versioned Backup Generation
Fixed 350-Byte Records)]:::datasource

    D1{Backup Completed
Successfully?
Return Code = 0}:::decision

    %% ─── STEP05: DELETE STEP ───
    E[STEP05 - IDCAMS DELETE
Safely Remove Existing Card Transaction
VSAM Cluster and Alternate Index
to Prepare for Fresh Re-creation]:::process

    DS3[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS
🗑️ Card Transaction VSAM Cluster
Scheduled for Deletion)]:::datasource

    DS4[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.AIX
🗑️ Card Transaction Alternate Index
Scheduled for Deletion)]:::datasource

    D2{Delete Return Code ≤ 8?
Files May Already Be Absent
Safe to Proceed Either Way}:::decision

    RC[⚙️ Reset Return Code to 0
Deletion Treated as Successful
Even if Files Did Not Exist]:::process

    %% ─── STEP10: CREATE STEP ───
    D3{STEP10 Condition Check
Prior Step Return Code ≤ 4?
OK to Create New VSAM File?}:::decision

    F[STEP10 - IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER
Create Brand New Empty Card Transaction
VSAM Key-Sequenced File with
Data and Index Components]:::process

    DS5[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS
✅ Newly Created Card Transaction VSAM File
Empty and Ready for Data Load
350-Byte Fixed Records, Keyed on 16-Byte Transaction ID)]:::datasource

    %% ─── END NODES ───
    G([✅ JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY
Card Transaction VSAM File Re-initialized
Backup Preserved, Old Files Removed
New Empty VSAM File Ready for Data Load]):::success

    ERR1([❌ JOB FAILED AT BACKUP STEP
Card Transaction Backup Could Not Be Created
Original VSAM File Preserved
No Further Steps Executed]):::error

    ERR2([❌ JOB FAILED AT DELETE STEP
Unexpected Error Deleting VSAM Files
Return Code Greater Than 8
No Further Steps Executed]):::error

    SKIP([⚠️ STEP10 SKIPPED
Prior Step Returned Error Code Greater Than 4
Card Transaction VSAM File Was NOT Re-created
Manual Intervention Required]):::error

    %% ─── FLOW CONNECTIONS ───
    A --> B

    DS1 -.->|📖 Read All Card Transaction Records
Full File Copy - No Filtering| B
    B -.->|💾 Write All Records to New
Versioned Backup Generation| DS2

    B --> D1
    D1 -->|✅ Yes - All Records Backed Up
New GDG Generation Cataloged| E
    D1 -->|❌ No - Backup Failed
Incomplete GDG Generation Deleted| ERR1

    DS3 -.->|🗑️ Delete Entire VSAM Cluster
Includes Data and Index Components| E
    DS4 -.->|🗑️ Delete Alternate Index
Removes Secondary Access Path| E

    E --> D2
    D2 -->|✅ Yes - RC ≤ 8| RC
    D2 -->|❌ No - RC > 8
Unexpected System Error| ERR2

    RC --> D3

    D3 -->|✅ Yes - RC ≤ 4
Environment Clean and Ready| F
    D3 -->|❌ No - RC > 4
